events.title: Thrive - Sheridan EDGE's Signature Entrepreneurship Program (Fall'26)
events.excerpt: Sheridan EDGE’s signature program for Sheridan students to develop venture ideas through 1:1 mentorship sessions with experienced mentors.
events.description:
This program is exclusively for Sheridan students & alumni only.
Free for Sheridan Students & Alumni | 2 months (7sessions) | Hybrid program
Thrive is an application-based hybrid program where Sheridan students develop business ideas and build practical entrepreneurial skills. Through one-on-one mentorship, participants strengthen the foundations of their ventures by refining ideas and building clear business models.
Please review application process to apply. Registering on Eventbrite alone does not complete your application. To apply, please submit your application using the link found in the Application Process section below.
Who should apply
Sheridan students or alumni who want to:
Develop an entrepreneurial mindset
Refine business concepts and models
Create social impact through their ideas
Build strong business plans and conduct market research
Accelerate the development of their ventures
What to expect
Weekly one-on-one virtual mentorship sessions with a mentor
Access to additional industry mentors when specialized guidance is needed
Online resources and tools through Google Classroom
Final pitch presentation
Benefits to Students
Personalized mentorship: One-on-one guidance from experienced mentors to refine ideas and navigate challenges.
Hands-on learning: Practical activities focused on building business plans and developing minimum viable products (MVPs).
Networking opportunities: Connections with peers, industry experts, and faculty advisors.
CCR credit and certification: Recognition through a certificate and Co-Curricular Record (CCR).
Launch support: Structured guidance that helps move ideas from concept to execution.
Learning modules: Free access to entrepreneurship and venture development resources.
Entrepreneurial community: Join a network of aspiring entrepreneurs and changemakers.
Coworking access : Pre-approved access to Sheridan EDGE coworking spaces.
Skill development: Opportunities to strengthen pitching and sales skills
Application Process
Applications open every term (Winter, Spring/Summer, Fall) and are reviewed on a rolling basis until all spots are filled.
Application Open Date: 4 th August 2026 (Monday)
Application Close Date: 15th September 2026 (Tuesday)
Selection Criteria:
Idea clarity: The idea addresses a clear problem or opportunity.
Impact: The venture demonstrates social impact and aligns with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
Application quality: The application is complete and clearly written.
Commitment: Applicants commit to seven mentorship sessions and weekly program work.
Motivation: Applicants demonstrate strong interest in completing the program.
Please submit the complete application form to be considered.
To apply for Fall 2026 Cohort, click here
Hosts
Sheridan EDGE
EDGE is a vibrant community of people who believe entrepreneurship can create lasting change in society. It’s also a hub for impact entrepreneurs to grow their ventures, collaborate and develop new skills. Impact entrepreneurs, talented students, experienced faculty and like-minded community and industry collaborators work together at EDGE to amplify social and economic impact. We’re an integral part of Sheridan’s Academic & Industry Integrations (aii) division that connects education and industry to empower learner success, strengthen partnerships and advance academic excellence. Visit https://edge.sheridancollege.ca
DISCLAIMER
Important Notes
This is a free program. Apply now to be eligible for screening.
Registering on Eventbrite alone does not complete your application. To apply, please submit your application
If you require any accommodation to apply for or to ensure your full participation in this program, please let us know at edge.students@sheridancollege.ca
Media Consent: Screenshots, photography and video recordings may be taken during this program. Your image may be used in printed and electronic publications for promotional and educational purposes and may be made available to the media and other third parties or published on the Internet. By registering for any of our events/programs, you understand and acknowledge that your image may be taken and used at our discretion. If you have concerns about your image being used for these purposes, please speak to one of the organizers.
More Programs and Events
To stay in the loop, sign up for our newsletter.

events.description:
Are you a domestic student at Sheridan looking to navigate the ins and outs of the Ontario Student Assistance Program (OSAP)? Join us for an informative webinar where we will guide you through the process of applying for financial aid to support your postsecondary education.
Whether you're a first-time applicant or looking to renew your OSAP funding, this webinar is designed to equip you with the knowledge and tools you need to navigate the financial aid process with confidence.
Join us and take the first step towards securing the financial support you need to pursue your educational goals!
Note: We will be providing OSAP account password resets/OAN retrieval at the end of each session. If you require this service, please come prepared with your Social Insurance Number (SIN) number and to answer your OSAP verification questions.

events.title: TD Insurance Webinar: Learn to invest with stocks
events.excerpt: Date: Friday, November 20 Time: 12:00 PM Location: Virtual Join us to learn how to start your stock investing journey! This beginner-friendly workshop is your starting point for stock investing…
events.description:
Date: Friday, November 20 Time: 12:00 PM Location: Virtual
Join us to learn how to start your stock investing journey! This beginner-friendly workshop is your starting point for stock investing. You’ll learn what stocks are, why they’re essential for long-term wealth, and how to match them to your goals and risk tolerance. We’ll cover stock types, potential returns, and market sectors, while also exploring how trading in a TFSA, RRSP, or non-registered account impacts taxation. Finally, you’ll gain practical tips on structuring your portfolio and finding the right balance of stocks to build confidence in your investing journey.
Register Now

At the event, explore the marketplace where you can discover unique products and services created by Sheridan student entrepreneurs. Support student-led ventures, network with peers, and win exciting gift cards! Whether you’re curious about entrepreneurship, looking to network or interested in joining the next cohort of Thrive, this event is for you!
Why should you attend?
You will watch student entrepreneurs pitch their ventures and learn what makes a strong business pitch.
You will expand your professional network by connecting with peers, industry professionals, and potential mentors in an energetic, startup-focused environment.
You’ll meet the Sheridan EDGE team, learn about the Thrive entrepreneurship program, and all the resources available to students for free.
Who Should Attend?
All Sheridan students
Students interested in learning about entrepreneurship
Aspiring student entrepreneurs
Hosts
Sheridan EDGE
EDGE is a vibrant community of people who believe entrepreneurship can create lasting change in society. It’s also a hub for impact entrepreneurs to grow their ventures, collaborate and develop new skills. Impact entrepreneurs, talented students, experienced faculty and like-minded community and industry collaborators work together at EDGE to amplify social and economic impact. We’re an integral part of Sheridan’s Academic & Industry Integrations (aii) division that connects education and industry to empower learner success, strengthen partnerships and advance academic excellence. Visit https://edge.sheridancollege.ca

events.title: Drag Show & Conversation with Sanjina DaBish (TRAF)
events.excerpt: Get ready for the tea AND the slay! 💅🏽✨ Join Canada’s Drag Race star Sanjina DaBish Queen and Sheridan alum Jessie James at The Marquee on November 27 for an unforgettable evening of drag, real talk, and fabulous performances! 🪩 Grab your tickets!
events.description:
REGISTER NOW | FREE EVENT | All Ages | Sheridan Students, Staff & Faculty | Each attendee must have their own ticket
Conversations & Catwalks 💃
Canada’s Drag Race star Sanjina DaBish Queen is taking over The Marquee alongside Sheridan alum Jessie James for a night of real talk, big personalities, and fierce drag! In honour of Transgender Awareness Week , we're celebrating self-expression and the magic of drag. Come for the conversation, stay for the slay! 💖
November 27th
First, we're getting into the tea with an interactive, conversation where the Queens will share their stories, experiences, and journeys as transgender women through the world of drag. Then, it's time to turn the party UP! 🪩 Get ready for a fabulous drag show. Expect charisma, confidence, wonderful performances and looks that will have you gagging!
Meet the Queens:
Sanjina Dabish
From Surrey, British Columbia, Sanjina DaBish Queen is a powerhouse trans drag artist who is taking Toronto by storm. With an infectious energy and mesmerizing dance moves, Sanjina has a unique ability to put audiences in a trance and get everyone moving on the dance floor. Proudly embracing her identity as a trans woman of Indo-Fijian descent, she is a true representation of strength and artistry.
As the self-proclaimed "Trans, Fijian, Bolly-hood queen of Toronto", she is known for her vibrant performances that beautifully blend her cultural roots with contemporary flair. She gained national recognition as the beloved sweetheart of Season 1 of the hit TV show “Call Me Mother,” and shone brightly as a standout star in Season 5 of “Canada’s Drag Race.”
She's a firecracker with a larger-than-life personality and she stands in her power and truth, being a voice for her trans siblings in the world, dazzling audiences with energetic and unforgettable performances, and using her platform to share her story with other people who need to hear it.
Jessie James
A self-described music theatre major gone rogue, Sheridan Alumn Jessie James , is a queer and trans, multi-disciplinary drag artist currently based in Hamilton, ON. Originally, getting her start in London, ON. Jessie has been dazzling audiences for 6 years now, bringing a punk, grunge-y flare to everything they do. Get ready cause she’s coming in hot to give you the show of your dreams (and sometimes nightmares).

events.description:
What does it mean to be alive?
Decades after its debut, the iconic Sondheim classic, Company, remains as funny, relevant and thought-provoking as ever. Winning four Tony Awards, including Best Musical, this brilliantly written score has inspired audiences around the world through its authentic portrayal of the human experience. With a fresh and biting comedic edge, Theatre Sheridan's Company offers an honest and hilarious look at modern relationships, exploring marriage, friendship and everything in between.
Company will be playing in the Studio Theatre from December 5–18, 2026.
Company is presented through special arrangement through Music Theatre International (MT). All authorized performance materials are also supplied by MTI. www.mtishows.com
Music and lyrics by Stephen Sondheim Book by George Furth Originally produced and directed on Broadway by Harold Prince Orchestrations by Jonathan Tunick
Director: Kate Hennig Music Director: Athena So Set Designer: Shannon Lea Doyle Costume Designer: Brooke Logie

events.title: The Addams Family
events.excerpt: Snap your fingers and join your favourite (but frightening) family! In one fateful, hilarious, and deceptively normal night, relationships are tested and truths are fully disclosed. Prepare yourself…
events.description:
Normal is overrated.
Snap your fingers and join your favourite (but frightening) family! In one fateful, hilarious, and deceptively normal night, relationships are tested and truths are fully disclosed. Prepare yourself to be pulled in a new direction with Theatre Sheridan's The Addams Family. In the kooky world of the living, dead and somewhere in between, explore a story of secrets, individuality and the chaos of what it means to be "normal." A hauntingly hilarious time of family and love where the Addams' confront their worst nightmare: change! Bring the whole bloodline and celebrate what it is to be an Addams!
The Addams Family will be playing in Macdonald Heaslip Hall from December 9–18, 2026.
The Addams Family is presented through special arrangement with and all authorized performances materials are supplied by Theatrical Rights Worldwide 1180 Avenue of the Americas, Suite 640, New York, NY 10036. www.theatricalrights.com
Book by Marshall Brickman and Rick Elice Music and Lyrics by Andrew Lippa Orchestrations by Larry Hochman Based on characters created by Charles Addams

In collaboration with the Shaw Festival, Theatre Sheridan is bringing the swashbuckling adventure you've been craving to the stage. Adapted from the 1748 satirical novel by Tobias Smollett, The Adventures of Roderick Random keeps you on the edge of your seat, following our roguish hero through a series of unbelievable escapades, and leading to a future far beyond his imagination. Full to the brim of boisterous characters, and songs you'll be humming the whole way home, this is the coming of age story you don't want to miss. Join us for The Adventures of Roderick Random, and be swept away on the journey of lifetime.
The Adventures of Roderick Random will be playing in the Studio Theatre January 30–February 4, 2027.

events.excerpt: When Clara's father whisks her away to an antique hotel for the holidays, she's promised the "best Christmas ever." But how special can a family holiday be when the family looks so different than it…
events.description:
Is Christmas truly magic, or is it just a magic trick?
When Clara's father whisks her away to an antique hotel for the holidays, she's promised the "best Christmas ever." But how special can a family holiday be when the family looks so different than it once did?
Join Theatre Sheridan for a night of wonder and delight, and be among the first to experience this new adaptation before it takes the world by storm.
The Nutcracker will be playing in the Studio Theatre January 30–February 4, 2027.
Presented in collaboration with Bad Hats Theatre.
Adapted, written and directed by Fiona Sauder Music by Britta Johnson Dramaturgy by Matt Pilipiak
Inspired by Tchaikovsky's classic ballet, The Nutcracker is a captivating new musical that challenges the notion that real life can take a back seat when the fantasy of holiday magic takes centre stage. With a powerhouse team behind the wheel, Bad Hats Theatre (NARNIA) and Britta Johnson (LIFE AFTER) bring you the enchanting tale of a Christmas turned upside down.

events.description:
Big Broadway personalities. Bigger small-town drama.
With the support of four self-obsessed Broadway stars, a repressed teen lesbian fights for inclusivity after being excluded from her senior prom. From the writer of Theatre Sheridan's sold-out hit The Drowsy Chaperone, the campy and outrageous world of The Prom reminds us that everyone deserves their chance to shine. Heartfelt and hilarious, it's full of big personalities, bigger dance numbers and an unforgettable celebration of being unapologetically yourself. Come see the honest and inspiring story that proves standing up for who you are can change everything.
The Prom will be playing in the Studio Theatre from March 27–April 10, 2027.
The Prom is presented through special arrangement with and all authorized performance materials are supplied by Theatrical Rights Worldwide 1180 Avenue of the Americas, Suite 640, New York, NY 10036. www.theatricalrights.com

events.description:
Once Upon A Time just got a whole lot whackier…
Tap dancing rats, burp competitions and a princess stuck in a dragon-guarded tower! Bring the whole family for a swamp-load of fairytale fun with Shrek the Musical. Jam-packed with laughs, heart, adventure and surprises around every corner, Theatre Sheridan presents the larger-than-life musical that proves true beauty comes from within. In this kingdom, even the biggest misfits can find their happily ever after.
Shrek the Musical will be playing in Macdonald Heaslip Hall from March 31–April 10, 2027.
Shrek the Musical is presented through special arrangement through Music Theatre International (MTI). All authorized performance materials are also supplied by MTI. www.mtishows.com
Book and lyrics by David Lindsay–Abaire Music by Jeanine Tesori Originally produced on Broadway by DreamWorks Theatricals and Neal Street Productions
